title: Kindred
text: "Kindred. Another ship. Another colony. And she thinks we're the thing to be afraid of."

lines.text: "Don't answer that. Come home. If we're going to answer her, or go and look at that moon, we'll need a shuttle, and somewhere to launch it from."

choices.label: Return to Touchdown
choices.reply: The convoy turns for home. Behind it the dish keeps listening.

choices.label: Stay on the Heights a while
choices.reply: The expedition stays. The Command Core can take us home whenever we're ready.

effects.text: Research Orbital Launch at a Tech Lab (after Isotope Cells): it unlocks the Launch Gantry, and routes off the planet.
